label: 深夜食堂
description: V5 写实模板：深夜食堂（夜晚家庭厨房，风格 film_interview）

acts.name: 第 1 幕
acts.visual: A gas stove in a real home kitchen at night, blue flame under a wok, steam rising, warm tungsten light, the camera pushes in on the sizzling pan.

acts.name: 第 2 幕
acts.text: 深夜的厨房，是这座城市最后的客厅，谁都能坐。
acts.visual: Medium shot of a 38-year-old Chinese man in a dark coat standing in a warm home kitchen at night, steam and hanging lamp above the stove, he speaks to camera.

acts.name: 第 3 幕
acts.text: 开火就行，想吃啥说一声，锅里正热着。
acts.visual: A 48-year-old Chinese chef in a dark apron stands at the stove stirring a wok, steam rising, warm hood light on his weathered face as he speaks to camera.

acts.name: 第 4 幕
acts.visual: A wooden kitchen table with bowls of food, steam curling under a warm pendant lamp, chopsticks resting on a bowl, the camera glides across the table.

acts.name: 第 5 幕
acts.text: 加完班闻到这口热气，才觉得自己又活过来了。
acts.visual: A 26-year-old Chinese man in a grey hoodie and glasses sits at the kitchen table, steam rising from the bowl in front of him, warm lamp light, he speaks to camera and smiles.

acts.name: 第 6 幕
acts.text: 一日三餐认真吃，就是普通人最了不起的坚持。
acts.visual: Medium-close shot of the host leaning against the kitchen counter at night, warm lamp light and steam around him, he speaks to camera then looks toward the table.

scenes.label: 家庭厨房
scenes.description: 真实家庭厨房的夜晚：吊灯暖光、灶台与锅、橱柜、小餐桌，有生活痕迹的厨房。

scenes.label: 厨房餐桌
scenes.description: 真实厨房小餐桌：木桌、热汤热菜、头顶暖灯、蒸汽升起，适合坐下吃饭的对谈。

scenes.label: 灶台特写
scenes.description: 真实家用灶台：灶火、炒锅、升腾的热气、抽油烟机的暖光，适合做饭与食物 B-roll。

closing_broll.visual: Final wide shot of the small home kitchen at night: warm light, steam, two bowls on the table, the window reflecting city lights, the camera slowly rises.

meta.note: 夜晚家庭厨房：灶台 / 餐桌 / 暖灯
